## Context / Problem

Current-base archaeology shows that `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:414-418` registers `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review`, but no bare `review` command. `AGENTS.md` names only the live commands; it does not instruct a bare invocation. In contrast, `docs/exit-codes.md:184` still has a `review` table row that describes a deprecated forwarding shim. The table row is stale and misstates the current CLI contract.

## Approach

Delete the stale bare-`review` row from `docs/exit-codes.md`. Retain the accurate `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review` rows unchanged except for any immediately necessary table formatting. Do not add a command-reference generator and do not change the CLI registry: source inspection is the verification boundary, not an implementation target.

## Scope

- `docs/exit-codes.md` — remove the stale deprecated `review` shim row.
- Read-only verification: `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py` establishes the live command set; `AGENTS.md` is searched only to confirm no obsolete invocation is present.

## Testing

Run the existing documentation checks. Confirm the registry has no bare `review` route and run an anchored maintained-guidance search, `rg -n 'rebar review($|[^-])' AGENTS.md README.md docs`, so `review-plan` and `review-code` cannot satisfy or fail the check accidentally.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/exit-codes.md` contains no table row or prose that presents bare `review` as an available or forwarding CLI command.
- [ ] The documented `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review` exit-code rows remain accurate and present.
- [ ] Anchored maintained-guidance search finds no bare `rebar review` invocation; `rebar review-plan` and `rebar review-code` are not false positives.
- [ ] Existing documentation checks pass without expanding command-reference generation ownership.
